style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

⟦0⟧ Ideology group of the party. desc = <localisation key> A description used for the rule. Optional, defaults to being the same as default. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
set_party_rule = { ideology = democratic desc = TAG_my_rule_description can_create_factions = yes }
Toggles the special game rules for the current scope's political party.

⟦0⟧ Target of the rule. usage_desc = <localisation key> A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional. trigger = <scripted trigger> A scripted trigger deciding when the override should be active. Optional, defaults to always true. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
add_relation_rule_override = { target = SOV usage_desc = TAG_my_rule_description trigger = my_scripted_trigger can_access_market = yes }
Toggles the special game rules for the current scope in diplomacy towards the specified country only, if the trigger is met.

Currently ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are supported. In case of overlap, restricting actions is preferred (e.g. ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ are preferred over the alternatives). In the scripted trigger, ⟦4⟧ is the country with the override and ⟦5⟧ is the target.

⟦0⟧ Target of the rule. usage_desc = <localisation key> A description used as the reason for the rule applying. Optional. trigger = <scripted trigger> A scripted trigger for identifying the relation rule. <rule> = <bool> Rule's new value.
remove_relation_rule_override = { target = SOV usage_desc = TAG_my_rule_description can_access_market = yes }
Plays the specified sound once only for the current country.
The sound effect must be properly defined in ⟦0⟧ More info can be found in the ⟦1⟧ article.
Plays an audio track for the specified country only.
The song must be defined in a music station in order to work. More information can be found in the ⟦0⟧ page. If you wish to simply play a sound, the scoped_sound_effect effect should be used instead.
⟦0⟧ The id of the province go to.
Moves the camera position over the specified province.
⟦0⟧ The id of the state go to.
Moves the camera position over the specified state.
Switches the player to the current scope from the target scope. Nothing happens if the target scope is controlled by AI.
⟦0⟧ For example, ⟦1⟧ will make the player controlling XYZ play as ABC instead.
The country the player becomes needs to be the scope in which the command is used.
Reserves the dynamic country, making sure that it does not get recycled for civil war even if it does not exist.
⟦0⟧ Triggers required for the map mode to refresh. Optional. mapmode = <id> The ID of the custom map mode.
force_update_map_mode = { limit = { is_ai = no } mapmode = my_map_mode }
Forcefully refreshes the specified mapmode for the player, rather than waiting for a daily update.
⟦0⟧ The type of strategy. id = <country> What country the strategy is against. value = <int> The weighting added by the strategy.
add_ai_strategy = { type = alliance id = GER value = 200 }
Sets an AI strategy for the current scope.

⟦0⟧ The original tag to be used by the country. copy_tag = <tag> If specified, copies stuff from this tag rather than the original tag. <effects> Effects that will be executed on the new dynamic country.
create_dynamic_country = { original_tag = POL copy_tag = SOV add_political_power = 100 transfer_state = 123 }
Creates a new dynamic country, akin to ones used in civil wars.

The ⟦0⟧ effect can be used if the dynamic country does not yet exist in order to ensure that it does not get overwritten by other creations of dynamic countries. If this is not done, the dynamic country will immediately stop existing if no states are transferred in the same scope. Every state of the original country immediately gets set as a dynamic country's core: if that's unneeded, the cores would need to be removed after creation.
These effects in particular are country-scoped effects that are related to states rather than effects within the state scope.
⟦0⟧ The state to add core to.
Adds a core for the current scope to the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The state to remove core from.
Removes the core of the current scope from the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The state to make capital. remember_old_capital = no Whether the old capital gets "remembered", making the country change to it in case the current capital is lost.
Makes the specified state the current scope's capital state.
Syntax has been changed in 1.11. It was "set_capital = 345" Old capital is remembered, if not specified otherwise.
⟦0⟧ The state to add a claim to.
Adds a claim for the current scope on the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The state to remove the claim from.
Removes a claim of the current scope from the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The state to change ownership of.
Makes the current scope the owner of the specified state.
This can fail to carry over the control, so it's recommended to instead use ⟦0⟧ unless transferring the ownership without transferring over the control.
⟦0⟧ The state to change controller of.
Makes the current scope the controller of the specified state.
Adds a contested owner to a state. The effect can be used either from a country or a state scope and accepts the other as parameter.
Can also be used in state scope.
Removes a contested owner to a state. The effect can be used either from a country or a state scope and accepts the other as parameter.
⟦0⟧ The state to change owner and controller of.
Makes the current scope the owner and controller of the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The province to change controller of.
Changes the controller of the specified province to the current scope.
A peace conference or the controller being at peace will reset the control of the province to the owner unless the controller is at war with the owner.
Mana in this usage means political power, stability, war support, and other values in the topbar. Fuel is, instead, in the ⟦0⟧, while convoys can be added/removed with ⟦1⟧.
Adds the specified amount of political power to the current scope.
Sets the specified amount of political power for the current scope.
Adds to the current stability value for the current scope.
Sets the current stability value for the current scope.
Adds to the current war support value for the current scope.
War Support values are between 0 and 1.
Sets the current war support value for the current scope.
Adds the specified amount of command power to the current scope.
Adds the specified amount of manpower to the current scope.
Adds the specified amount of army experience to the current scope.
Adds the specified amount of navy experience to the current scope.
Adds the specified amount of air experience to the current scope.
